Name: This week in Pelican Town
Author: Tomokisan1
Description:
[size=5][b]This Week in Pelican Town[/b][/size]

Ever wish the valley noticed everything you get up to? Now it does.

This mod adds a brand-new [b]"Local News"[/b] channel to any TV. Turn it on and your friendly local anchor recaps [b]what you actually did this week,[/b] pulled live from your own farmhand's deeds. No two broadcasts are the same, because the news is [i]your[/i] news.

[size=4][b]What makes the headlines?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fish reeled in at the docks[/*]
[*]Geodes cracked, ores mined, diamonds unearthed[/*]
[*]Gold that flowed through the local economy[/*]
[*]Monsters and slimes dealt with down in the caves[/*]
[*]How deep into the mines you dared to go[/*]
[*]Meals cooked, items crafted, crops planted, gifts given[/*]
[*]...and rare feats, find a Prismatic Shard and you'll be front-page news![/*]
[/list]
Quiet week? The anchor will happily tell you nothing much happened. Busy week? Only your biggest achievements make the cut.

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
Just install and watch a TV. The channel appears automatically and reports your activity for the current week (it refreshes as you play). That's it, no config needed.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works alongside [b]other TV channel mods,[/b] it adds its channel without removing anyone else's.[/*]
[*]Safe to add or remove at any time; it doesn't touch your save.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
Ships with [b]English, French, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский and Português (BR)[/b]. English and French are author-made; the others are machine-assisted, corrections from native speakers are very welcome. Adding a new language is as easy as dropping an [i]i18n/<locale>.json[/i] file.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
